593:t_002:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「There is one. A great shop in $$インダストリアル７$$.」

593:t_002:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go there when this battle is over.」

593:t_002:20.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... Asking someone out in a situation like this. You're bold and fearless.」

593:t_002:22.en:
$$クェス$$
「If $$ミネバ$$ heard that invitation just now, wouldn't you be in trouble?」

593:t_002:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Of course $$オードリー$$ is coming along too.」

593:t_002:27.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Wait, please! I didn't mean it like that...」

593:t_002:30.en:
$$宗介$$
「You were so tense that it was painful to watch, to the point that even $$レド$$ wanted to make a joke.」

593:t_002:33.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Feeling a little more relaxed now?」

593:t_002:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's not just the Gundam pilots who've got your back.」

593:t_002:36.en:
$$葵$$
「$c is going all out to back you up.」

593:t_002:37.en:
$$タケル$$
「So make sure you stop Ensign $$リディ$$. He was one of our comrades, after all.」

593:t_002:40.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I'll tell you now, $$マリーダ$$. Of course you're one of them too.」

593:t_002:41.en:
$$ファ$$
「So don't push yourself too hard. Though I imagine it's rough keeping up with $$バナージ$$'s recklessness.」

593:t_002:44.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Thank you, $$バナージ$$. You were trying to ease my nerves too, weren't you?」

593:t_002:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Someone might say I'm a fine one to talk, though.」

593:t_002:46.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But thanks to everyone, I've calmed down too.」

593:t_002:48.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Yes... All that's left is to give it everything I've got.」

593:t_002:50.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」

593:t_003:0.en:
$$カツ$$
「It's not just $$クロノ$$! The $$新地球皇国$$ is here too!」

593:t_003:1.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Seeing them cozy up to those guys this openly makes me feel more pathetic than angry.」

593:t_003:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「They're talking about you, $$リディ$$.」

593:t_003:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Accept reality already. I'm not your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$, and this man isn't your good-natured big-brother figure, Ensign $$リディ$$, either.」

593:t_003:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「We're enemies who came to crush you for our own purposes.」

593:t_003:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「Keep quiet. All I'll do is seal $$ラプラスの箱$$ to protect this world.」

593:t_003:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$...! You're still saying that...!」

593:t_003:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「Do you know the secret of $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

593:t_003:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「I don't need to answer you.」

593:t_003:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「All units, stall $c. I'll hold the $$ユニコーン$$ down.」

593:t_004:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then I'll help myself to $n without holding back.」

593:t_004:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Looks like there's one more guy who needs backing up.」

593:t_004:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「She's asked for you by name, $n! Take her on!」

593:t_005:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Watch, $n. I'll crush $c and drag you out.」

593:t_005:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't worry, $n! We'll take her on!」

593:t_005:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We'll slap that stuck-up woman around and drive her out of Miss $$スズネ$$!」

593:t_006:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, focus your attacks on the $$バンシィ$$! If we stop Ensign $$リディ$$, the battle is decided!」

593:t_006:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バナージ$$! You're the one who has to stop $$リディ$$!」

593:t_006:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「If anyone can save him, it can only be you.」

593:t_006:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You and Master pulled me out of the $$バンシィ$$. I believe in that light.」

593:t_006:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Leave the backup to me! The $$クシャトリヤ$$ will answer that call too!」

593:t_006:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$! If it weren't for you...!」

593:t_007:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, focus your attacks on the $$バンシィ$$! If we stop Ensign $$リディ$$, the battle is decided!」

593:t_007:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$! If it weren't for you...!」

593:t_008:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Not yet! Don't fall, $$バンシィ$$!」

593:t_008:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Get out of that machine right now! It's a dangerous machine!」

593:t_008:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up! Then what is your $$ユニコーン$$!?」

593:t_008:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「That machine, carrying a secret that leads humanity to ruin, is exactly what must not exist!」

593:t_008:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you talking about $$ラプラスの箱$$!」

593:t_008:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「I... To protect the world, I'll take you down!!」

593:t_009:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Share what you're carrying with us too! If you do...!」

593:t_009:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「What would you know! My destiny!」

593:t_009:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「As a member of the $$マーセナス家$$, tied to $$クロノ$$! And as someone who knows the truth!」

593:t_009:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! That kind of thing isn't...!」

593:t_002:47: Marida's trailing 後は… kept as an unfinished 'All that's left is...'
